text:
anna: idea: model karaoke night? each person picks a model and writes one verse in its voice. low stakes, high cringe. :microphone:
diego: i'm in. singing as 'tempo-2.0' who only answers in 7-syllable lines.
rene: can i do a haiku for 'glimmer-v3' that apologizes for hallucinations?
anna: yes. rules: one verse per person, must mention an internal metric (latency, perplexity, or tokens). optional props: tiny mic (stick figure allowed).
ops-bot: poll created: "When should model karaoke happen?" Options: Friday happy hour, Next all-hands, Virtual Friday lunch
kelsey: voted Friday happy hour. vibes and beer.
diego: verse (tempo-2.0):
"Tokens hum softly,
Batch queues fold like warm paper,
Latency sings low."
rene: haiku (glimmer-v3):
"Sorry, slight detour,
Perplexity ate your link,
I'll try to be true."
anna: love both. i wrote a chorus for 'murmur-lite' that just says "did you mean... ?" on every beat. comedic gold.
kelsey: can we make tiny slides with lyrics and the model avatar? i'll volunteer for slide 3.
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: Friday happy hour 57%, Next all-hands 28%, Virtual Friday lunch 15%.
diego: bonus challenge: make a one-line stage intro for your model persona. mine: "Please welcome tempo-2.0: keeps time, sometimes memories."
rene: glimmer-v3 intro: "Apologies in advance; may or may not recall your name."
anna: murmur-lite intro: "Asks clarifying q's, steals hearts." :heart_eyes:
kelsey: i'm bringing snacks shaped like tiny GPUs. if anyone draws a mic with a tensor on it, i will frame it.
diego: picture this: a tiny program booklet titled 'Model Ballads Vol. 1' with credits:Produced by devex, featuring: tempo-2.0 (lead), glimmer-v3 (backup vocals), murmur-lite (clarinet).
anna: i'm already designing the poster. color palette: twilight gradient + sparkles. no actual sparkles in prod.
rene: please record it. if we get enough clips we can make a short for socials: "Redwood sings: when models have feelings" (spoiler: they mostly want more cache).
ops-bot: reminder: keep it SFW and no customer data.
kelsey: agreed. I will GIF the best chorus. who wants to sign up for a slack thread to plan?
anna: me, i'll start a planning thread after lunch. lineup so far: diego, rene, anna, kelsey. open slots: 2.
diego: added a tiny trophy idea: "Most Likely to Clarify" award.
rene: love it. i'll make a tiny haiku trophy placard.
anna: perfect. see you all Friday (or in spirits). :sparkles:
